en: What became of its stratagem?
So died my hundred heroes,
With his belt cast around his neck,
Pleading with Zhelzhetpes,
His soul exhausted as though by truth itself,
Roaring as he became resolute,
Falling into sorrow upon sorrow,
The enemy appeared before their eyes,
His means exhausted, he burned within,
O children, descending from life,
The musket fired its shot,
Blood and watery tears from both eyes,
Life burned like a fire,
He fashioned it from a thousand words,
Zhelzhetpes, who had seen it from childhood,
No soul could wrestle with Zhelzhetpes,
He stood asking for counsel,
He began firmly, speaking softly,
O, to the children of Chandayak,
He struck them with truthful words.
O, the two heroes of the pale one,
Those equal in their wish,
A bitter day met in humiliation,
The many Turkic oppressors,
No soul remains when showers of blows fall,
When battle begins again, no blood remains,
The Chinese host, while we stand alone,
What was done was broken before God,
The spreading circuit reached its limit,
Whirling around, it ravaged the land,
His head broken, God struck him,
Knowing the reason for the shot that was fired,
Take away the children's remaining lives,
The khan's horde began to move,
Hold your head, hero Korok,
Chyntemir entered the hero's work,
Your hope needs counsel,
Against the wrathful multitude,
Into hardship harder than stone,
From the venom of the true kinsmen,
From the wrath of true God,
If you touch us, children, we shall die,
A soul burdened with worldly sorrow,
The army suffered humiliation before the enemy,
We shall place it in a pouch and give it,
A wise man, a champion among men,
We shall die where death awaits,
Into what belonged to the elder brother,
Written in place of a remedy,
He began as an elder brother,
He guarded them as a forefather,
The sovereign Kyrgyz, beloved people,
Let us leave the hero upon the earth,
Let us set out before the soul departs,
Let us scatter the abundant wealth,
Come, children, let us remain,
You will know, Baisal, the host of my Manas.
